title: Lantern Grid
brief: Tap festival lanterns on a 3x3 square; each tap flips that lantern and its neighbours. Light all nine within 8 taps to win, run out of taps and you lose.

title: Weed Patrol
brief: Steer the gardener around an 8x8 garden with the pad and walk into weeds to pull them; a weed left alone spreads seed. Pull 25 weeds to win; 14 weeds at once or three wasp stings and you lose.

title: Log Bridge
brief: A beaver steps one cell per tap and pushes logs into a two-row river; a log in open water sinks into a plank, and two planks in one column make a crossing. Reach the lodge on both creeks to win; stepping into open water or meeting the crocodile ends the run.

title: Gem Ladder
brief: Swipe to send a marble sliding across an ice cave until something stops it; it can only swallow gems in rising order of power, and any other gem stops it like a rock. Take all four gems in each of three caves to win; stopping on a crack three times loses.

title: Dough Drop
brief: Tap one of five chutes to drop a dough ball down its column; a ball landing on an equal ball kneads into one twice as big, and kneads can chain down a well-ordered column. Knead a 64 loaf to win; a ball that comes to rest in the top row overflows the tray and loses.

title: Stitch Quilt
brief: Step a needle one square per tap; every square it leaves gets a stitch it cannot cross again, and a fully stitched 3x3 patch or column lifts off the frame and frees its squares. Finish six patches to win; running out of thread (each step and each unpick costs some) loses.

title: Bean Sorter
brief: Coffee beans drop one at a time down the middle lane of a chute; swipe each into the light-roast jar on the left or the dark-roast jar on the right before it lands (gold beans count in either jar and give a life back). Sort 20 beans to win; wrong jars and spilled beans cost lives.

title: Brick Crane
brief: A crane swings back and forth across a six-cell shaft on its own; tap DROP to release a brick that falls and sets, and every full course of six bricks is carted away. Clear eight courses to win; a brick that sets on the red line topples the wall.

title: Circuit Runner
brief: Tap GO to send a spark along a circuit board, and tap the arrow switches to turn it; one switch must be re-pointed while the spark is still looping. Light all six LEDs in a single run to win; hitting a resistor or the board edge shorts the spark, darkens the LEDs and costs one of three lives.

title: Night Library
brief: Steer the librarian through the stacks with the pad: she keeps walking until a shelf stops her, picks up one returned book at a time and carries it to the desk, and can shove book trolleys (which can jam the gaps). Shelve 15 books to win; ten books piled up at once or the closing-time clock running out loses.

title: Cauldron Swipe
brief: Swipe to slide every ingredient on a 5x5 kitchen board; two equal ingredients steep into the next kind, and a new sprig drops in after every swipe. Get a crystal or better to come to rest on the cauldron square five times to win; running out of 80 swipes loses.

title: Crate Bay
brief: Crates of seven shapes fall into a warehouse bay six cells wide; swipe to shift, turn and shove them. Pack a 3x3 pallet space completely to ship it (full rows also clear but do not count); ship four pallets to win, and a crate settling at the loading dock jams the bay and loses.

title: Freight Yard
brief: Wagons of five shapes roll in from the right and run left until they buffer up; tap UP and DOWN to switch tracks, TURN to swing a wagon round and NUDGE to roll it on. Fill a column across all six tracks to send off a train; dispatch five trains to win, and a wagon left standing in the entry throat blocks the yard and loses.

title: Locksmith
brief: A key blank shaped like a falling block drops toward a lock; tap left, right, turn and push to slide it into the keyhole until it touches the gold pin. Open three locks (one with a sweeping tumbler, one with a decoy keyhole) to win; every key that lands anywhere else costs a pick, and losing all five picks ends the game.

title: Tilt Tray
brief: Swipe to tip a studded tray so every ruby and sapphire marble rolls at once until something stops it; a marble that comes to rest on a cup of its own colour drops in. Sink every marble on three trays to win; using up the 40-tilt budget loses (RETRY restarts the current tray).
